climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Mâconnais appellation for white wine made only from Chardonnay, in Vinzelles and Loché. It has no premier cru vineyards and sits next to Pouilly-Fuissé and just south of Pouilly-Loché.
